findings.kind: raw LaTeX inside CSS uppercase proof-technique banner
findings.source_text: **Proof technique:** direct; specialise the signature theorem to $k=1$.
findings.rendered: The CSS uppercase technique banner prints the dollar delimiters and k=1 literally. The formula in the statement and proof body renders correctly.
findings.repair: Use math-free wording in the technique label, e.g. “specialise the signature theorem to degree one”.

candidates.claim: The disk with two holes has oriented boundary -(C1 sqcup C2) sqcup C0 and is an oriented bordism from C1 sqcup C2 to C0.
candidates.why: A planar sketch would make the three boundary components and the outward-normal-first sign convention directly checkable: C0 is counterclockwise, while C1 and C2 are clockwise as induced boundary orientations.
candidates.content_to_draw: A disk with two removed disks; label outer C0 and inner C1,C2; orient outer boundary counterclockwise and both inner boundaries clockwise; mark C1 sqcup C2 incoming and C0 outgoing.
candidates.status: optional and source-supported; not required because the source states the region and explicitly derives all three induced boundary orientations.
